crossRefs.note: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son.…
I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.
Now, because you have done all these works,” says Yahweh, “and I spoke to you, rising up early and speaking, but you…

to listen to the words of my servants the prophets, whom I send to you, even rising up early and sending them, but you…
Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed…

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Jordan
people.line: A river and region, significant in Israel's history

people.name: Joshua
people.line: Moses' assistant who led Israel into Canaan

people.name: Shittim
people.line: The last Israelite campsite before crossing the Jordan.

translations.web: Joshua got up early in the morning; and they moved from Shittim and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel. They camped there before they crossed over.
translations.bsb: Early the next morning Joshua got up and left Shittim with all the Israelites. They went as far as the Jordan, where they camped before crossing over.
translations.kjv: And Joshua rose early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to Jordan, he and all the children of Israel, and lodged there before they passed over.
translations.asv: And Joshua rose up early in the morning; and they removed from Shittim, and came to the Jordan, he and all the children of Israel; and they lodged there before they passed over.
